glyphs.notes: Exact GNU Unifont U+006F lowercase o remap; all 128 pixels preserved. Native body occupies rows 6–13 and columns 1–6.
Exact GNU Unifont U+0063 lowercase c remap. The right aperture between the two native terminals remains open through rows 8–11.
Exact GNU Unifont U+0254 remap. Native open-o body and simple c-like terminals; no added weight on either free left terminal.
Exact GNU Unifont U+0131 DOTLESS I remap, including the two-pixel head at row 6, column-4 stave, and five-pixel foot at row 13. This corrects the former plain-bar starter.
Exact GNU Unifont U+006C lowercase l remap: the dotless-i head moves to row 3, and the body and baseline foot remain unchanged.

Move the native lowercase-f hook one column right to the dotless-i axis: row 3 pixels (5,3) and (6,3), then column 4 from row 4. Omit f’s unrelated crossbar. Retain the complete dotless-i baseline foot at row 13, columns 2–6.

Retain the dotless-i head at (3,6) and (4,6). Continue the column-4 stave through row 14 and move the complete five-pixel dotless-i foot from row 13 to row 15; the straight descent has no baseline crossbar. Native p/q supply the two-row descender-depth precedent.

Use lowercase l’s two-pixel head at row 3 and its column-4 vertical. Continue the column-4 stave through row 14 and move the complete five-pixel dotless-i foot from row 13 to row 15; the straight descent has no baseline crossbar. Native p/q supply the two-row descender-depth precedent.

Retain the dotless-i head at (3,6) and (4,6). Continue the column-4 stave through row 13. Adapt dotless-j’s lower return to the common axis: row 14 columns 1 and 4, row 15 columns 2 and 3. Preserve the native left return and avoid a dot, crossbar, or column-0 ink.
reviewNotes: Review the compressed two-row left tail at native size; its diagonal lower return uses 8-neighbor continuity and the row-14 left pixel is part of that return, not a detached dot.
